subject: Circle of hours — propose rotating demo windows for Medistar pilot
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Andy Liu <andy.li@medistar.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Circle of hours — follow-up & proposed rotating windows

Hi Andy — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps from my side: 

- Recap: discovery call with Andy (Medistar) + Priyanka scheduled to review clinic workflows and integration constraints. Primary goals: evaluate Redwood for real-time summarization at clinician shift handoff and evaluate data residency controls.
- Next: schedule a technical deep-dive (30–45m) with your engineers and our solutions team.

Availability challenge we discussed: global stakeholder set (US west, UK, Japan). To avoid repeatedly asking everyone for ad-hoc swaps, I put together a rotating weekly window proposal so the meeting falls in reasonable local hours for each region over a 3-week rotation. Thoughts?

Proposal (recurring series, rotate by week):
- Week A (US-first): Tue 09:00–09:45 PT / Tue 12:00–12:45 ET (works for west-coast ops)
- Week B (EU-first): Wed 09:00–09:45 CET / Wed 08:00–08:45 UK time
- Week C (APAC-first): Thu 10:00–10:45 SGT / Thu 02:00–02:45 PDT (early for US, but one-off every third week)

Why this pattern: each participating region gets a morning-friendly slot once per rotation and the sequence repeats so no one is always in the odd hour. If those specific local times look off for Medistar clinicians, we can shift the band +/- 30–60 minutes.

I attached the short discovery notes and a sample .ics showing the rotation so you can preview the set. Can you confirm which weeks your team prefers to start with (US-first / EU-first / APAC-first)? If you'd like, I can also create a quick Doodle/When2Meet to collect hard availability.

Attendees (recommended):
- Andy Liu (Medistar) — product lead
- Priyanka Rao (Medistar) — clinical ops (UK)
- Kenji Sato (Medistar) — infra/PII (Japan)
- Ben Carter (Redwood) — Solutions Engineer (technical deep-dive)
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — Platform architect (performance & deployment)

From: Andy Liu <andy.li@medistar.health>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Rao <p.rao@clinix.co.uk>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@careplus.jp>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Circle of hours — follow-up & proposed rotating windows

Diego — thanks for the clear recap and the thoughtful rotation idea. This is promising and better than ad-hoc swapping. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Priyanka and I prefer not to be earlier than 08:30 UK time on weekdays due to clinic scheduling. Kenji is flexible but needs to avoid after-hours (he's UTC+9 and prefers 09:00–17:00 JST).
- Our prefered pattern would be EU-first in the rotation (so Priyanka gets morning slots most often). If we go EU-first, can you shift the EU slot to 09:30 CET (09:30 UK on DST change? we can confirm exact offsets as we lock dates)

Availability windows (these are recurring windows where we can typically take the meeting):
- Tue/Thu 14:00–17:00 CET (Priyanka)
- Wed 08:00–11:00 CET (Andy)
- Mon/Wed 10:00–16:00 JST (Kenji)

If EU-first works for Redwood, we should aim to start the rotation in the week of Nov 2 so internal approvals and scheduling align. Also please share any pre-reads for the SE deep-dive (SLA/latency targets, data flows).

Thanks,
Andy

--
Andy Liu
Head of Product
Medistar Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Andy Liu <andy.li@medistar.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Circle of hours — follow-up & proposed rotating windows

Thanks Andy — EU-first is fine. Updated plan below and two concrete options to pick from so we can lock an invite: 

Option 1 (EU-first rotation) — start week of Nov 2:
- Week 1 (EU-first): Wed 09:30–10:15 CET / Wed 08:30–09:15 UK / Wed 17:30–18:15 JST (may be late for JP; we note Kenji prefers earlier but said flexible)
- Week 2 (APAC-first): Thu 10:00–10:45 SGT / Thu 03:00–03:45 UTC-7 (early US)
- Week 3 (US-first): Tue 09:00–09:45 PT / Tue 12:00–12:45 ET (friendly for west coast)

Option 2 (EU-first, tighter hours):
- Week 1 (EU): Wed 09:30–10:00 CET (30m focused tech deep-dive)
- Week 2 (APAC): Thu 09:30–10:00 SGT
- Week 3 (US): Tue 09:00–09:30 PT

If you confirm Option 1 vs Option 2 I will: 
- generate the recurring series .ics and a single placeholder invite for the first three occurrences (so your calendar gets the pattern),
- create a brief agenda and attach the pre-read (latency targets, integration checklist), and
- log the availability choice in HubSpot (HS-45891 / deal RDW-4552) so our CS handoff is clean.

Ben & Karthik — can you weigh in on whether 45m (Option 1) vs 30m (Option 2) is better for a first technical session? If 30m we should be strict on agenda: integration touchpoints + data controls + next steps.

[attachment: proposed-rotating-slots.ics (Calendar file)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Circle of hours — follow-up & proposed rotating windows (internal)

Quick internal note for the team before we lock: 

- Ben: please prepare the short runbook (10 slides) that covers integration touchpoints (API auth, KV cache behavior, tokenization), a sample perf target for 1k concurrent sessions, and a short demo plan in case Medistar asks for an on-call latency check.
- Karthik: have the deployment/region guidance ready (options for EU data residency, private VPC path).
- Diego: send the EU-first Option 1 as the default to Andy but include a tight 30m fallback (Option 2) if Kenji requests earlier JST times.

I'll create the placeholder invites after Ben confirms the runbook and I have the pre-read files (SLA excerpt + minimal architecture diagram).

Marissa
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 16:12:00 +0900

Diego — EU-first Option 1 looks good to us. We can start the rotation the week of Nov 2. A couple of asks before the session: 

1) Please send the SOW draft and a short data protection checklist ahead of the call (this is required by our procurement).
2) Can you make the Week 1 EU slot Wed 09:30 CET (09:30 UK) as proposed. That timing works for Priyanka and me. Kenji will join where the time is reasonable; if Wed is late for him he can dial in when possible.

We'll pencil in the first occurrence: Wed, Nov 4, 09:30 CET. Thanks — looking forward to the technical deep-dive.

Best,
Andy
